# SETL: Focus on Life.

> SETL (pronounced settle) is an iPhone app blocker built bedtime first. SETL Sleep blocks chosen distracting apps automatically at bedtime every night; SETL Sessions blocks them on demand for daytime focus; SETL Plans schedules nights off. Built in the UK by founder Jacob Redshaw. Pricing: $39.99 a year ($3.33 a month), $5.99 a month or $2.99 a week. Free nights: 7 on yearly, 3 on monthly, 1 on weekly. iPhone only.

In one line: A screen blocker app specialising in automated distraction relief, night and day. Built for ADHD brains, deep focus and anyone with a busy life.

Also searched as: SETL Sleep, setl, settle sleep, SETL app blocker.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/setl.sleep/

In SETL's 2026 beta, testers reported an average of 4 hours 3 minutes less screen time a day (about 3 hours by day, 1 hour at night).
